requirement: TSK-11 使用者可以將有授權的真實任務資料帶入框架；每類任務實際匯入、訓練、推論與評估
scope: Five small real-data examples cover speech-to-text, text generation, single-character OCR, text-conditioned image/audio/video, and fruit-fly trajectory one-step prediction. Navigation evidence is observer-pose, teacher-forced and not closed-loop; TSK-11 is not passed.
reproduction_command: See each child verification.json for data import, training, independent inference, evaluation and repeated-run commands. External raw data, snapshots and training reports remain outside Git.

environment.machine: Mac15,12 Apple M3, 16 GiB unified memory
environment.gpu_scope: All five real-data example training workflows used the CPU CoImNet sparse core; no Ubuntu or RTX4070 execution.

observed_result.status: partial: five main-spec task classes have small real-data workflow evidence, but trajectory work is only one-step prediction, not closed-loop navigation; model quality is limited

ocr.scope: KMNIST single character, not page OCR

image_audio_video.scope: Two source films, 8x8 RGB at 4 fps, 8 kHz mono, 2 seconds
image_audio_video.generated_artifacts: PNG, WAV, timeline, MP4 with synchronized container tracks; source film and trained model stay outside Git

navigation.scope: trial-held-out, teacher-forced next-displacement prediction from observer pose and prior displacement; no closed-loop target return

limitations: Main specification section 13.6 includes spatial/navigation; the real trajectory example covers only observer-pose one-step prediction, not closed-loop navigation or return success.
Speech held-out CER worsened and WER stayed 1.0; no natural ASR quality claim.
Text held-out perplexity improved but generated text remained fragmented.
KMNIST covers one character per image, not natural page OCR.
Media held-out balanced and temporal-delta MSE worsened, audio MSE worsened, and generated frames were nearly black; output does not match the visual prompt.
Trajectory held-out next-displacement MSE and angular error worsened and underperformed causal persistence; no learned navigation claim.
All runs are bounded small examples, not trained fruit-fly models, full datasets, model generalization or GPU acceleration.
Historical blocked-data evidence is retained in evidence/TSK-11/verification-20260924-blocked.json.
The full race suite started before the final output-path-only fix; the changed realnav and trajectory packages passed a separate race run after that fix. Other packages were unchanged.
